titulo: DEVO v2 — Rato, retrato em pose (meio corpo, ref. Persona)
prompt: Bold clean anime lineart, two-tone cel shading, high-contrast graphic poster style. Half-body portrait from mid-thigh up, plain flat dusty slate-blue background, headroom above the hat and ears. An anthropomorphic rat gentleman in three-quarter view, chest puffed out like a ringmaster, wide delighted grin; his left hand tips the brim of his top hat; his right hand makes a single face-down card vanish between two fingers in a puff of absinthe sparks, relaxed hand, five fingers clearly separated. Grey-beige fur, two huge round ears with pink insides, long wedge snout, black nose, long thin whiskers, two long front incisors, eyes that are black four-hole sewing buttons stitched with gold X stitches. Tall crooked black top hat tilted toward the viewer's left with a burgundy hatband; black high-collared tailcoat lined with absinthe billiard felt; burgundy damask waistcoat with brass coin buttons; mustard cravat; brass chain of old holed coins; bare pink-tipped tail curling behind. Hard circus spotlight from above, absinthe rim light. Palette: black #0D0C10, absinthe #A8C82E, old brass #B08A4A. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, low detail, pixel art, extra fingers, extra limbs
